state_equation: Column state vectors obey dx/dt=A*x, A=[[-gamma,-omega],[omega,-gamma]]. Gamma is one unknown common nonnegative decay rate, omega is fixed by a candidate. A response-matrix column is the measured state starting from the corresponding standard basis vector.
fit_policy: Infer the common decay rate using only the regular-grid training response matrices, freeze it and retain every candidate matching all training entries. Then validate every retained candidate on every held-out response entry without refitting gamma or omega. The displayed tiny near-zero entries are ordinary floating representations, not extra observed phases.

provenance.kind: Project-authored exact forward simulation of a stable2Dlinear quadrature-signal model for a sampling/identification audit, not an experimental transient or a Markov probability process.
